scenarios.title: The Team Thanksgiving
scenarios.text: The veterans host a holiday dinner for the young players who can't go home.

choices.label: Go and help cook
choices.result: You go early and help cook. The veteran's family adopts you for the night.

choices.label: Go and eat
choices.result: You go, eat too much and go home happy.

choices.label: Bring something meaningful
choices.result: You bring a dish from home and tell the story behind it.

scenarios.title: The Teammate's Baby
scenarios.text: A teammate's baby is born on a game week, and the whole locker room celebrates.

choices.label: Organize a gift
choices.result: You organize a team gift for the baby. The teammate tears up.

choices.label: Congratulate him
choices.result: You congratulate him and go back to your routine.

choices.label: Cover his duties
choices.result: You offer to cover his special teams meeting notes so he can be home.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Year Review
scenarios.text: {coach} sits you down for an honest review of your first season.

choices.label: Take notes
choices.result: You take notes on everything and ask follow-up questions. You leave with a plan.

choices.label: Ask for the hard truths
choices.result: You ask for the three hardest truths. You get them, and you work on them all summer.

choices.label: Share your own review
choices.result: You bring your own review and compare. The coach is impressed you thought about it.

scenarios.title: The Offseason Without Structure
scenarios.text: For the first time in your life, nobody tells you what to do all summer.

choices.label: Build your own plan
choices.result: You build a strict plan and follow it. You come back stronger.

choices.label: Take a real break
choices.result: You take three weeks off completely. You come back hungry.

choices.label: Train with friends
choices.result: You train with old college teammates. It's fun and it's real work.

scenarios.title: The Old College Rival
scenarios.text: A kicker you competed against in college is now on a rival club.

choices.label: Reach out
choices.result: You text him before your first game against his club. You have dinner after.

choices.label: Use the rivalry
choices.result: You use the rivalry as fuel all week.

choices.label: Study his film
choices.result: You study his film and learn something about your own technique.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Hazing Report
scenarios.text: A reporter asks you, on the record, about the club's rookie traditions.

choices.label: Keep it light
choices.result: You say the traditions are mostly about pastries and pads. It's true, and it's enough.

choices.label: Speak up about one
choices.result: You say the one tradition that made you uncomfortable should change. The captains agree, quietly.

choices.label: Decline to comment
choices.result: You say you'd rather not talk about the locker room.

scenarios.title: The Fan Who Sends Gifts
scenarios.text: A fan sends gifts to the facility every week, and they're getting stranger.

choices.label: Tell security
choices.result: You tell the club's security staff. They handle it kindly and firmly.

choices.label: Send a thank-you, once
choices.result: You send one thank-you note and ask the fan to stop sending gifts. It works.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: You ignore it. The gifts keep coming.

scenarios.title: Your First Endorsement Shoot
scenarios.text: The commercial shoot takes eleven hours for fifteen seconds of you holding a sports drink.

choices.label: Nail every take
choices.result: You nail every take and the director asks you back.

choices.label: Make the crew laugh
choices.result: You make the crew laugh between takes. It's the best part of the day.

choices.label: Survive it
choices.result: You survive it. Your face hurts from smiling.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Who Wants Your Spot
scenarios.text: An undrafted kicker in camp keeps showing up early and kicking where you can see.

choices.label: Show up earlier
choices.result: You show up earlier. He shows up earlier. You both get better.

choices.label: Help him
choices.result: You give him a tip about his plant foot. He thanks you, and still wants your job.

choices.label: Ignore and focus
choices.result: You ignore him and focus on your charts. The coaches notice your calm.

scenarios.title: The New Club as a Rookie
scenarios.text: Released after your first camp and signed somewhere new, you're starting your rookie year over.

choices.label: Learn every name fast
choices.result: You learn every name in the new building by Friday. Nobody owes you anything, and that starts to change.

choices.label: Kick like it's a tryout
choices.result: You kick every practice like it's a tryout, because it still is.

choices.label: Ask what they saw in you
choices.result: You ask {coach} what the club saw in your film. It's a list to build on.

scenarios.title: The First Time You Hear Boos
scenarios.text: Fans boo at a practice open to the public, and you know who they mean.

choices.label: Kick through it
choices.result: You kick through it and make the next ten. The boos stop.

choices.label: Wave
choices.result: You wave at the boo section. They laugh, and so do you.

choices.label: Ask the psychologist for a tool
choices.result: You ask the team psychologist for one tool for crowd noise. It works.

scenarios.title: The Phone Call Home
scenarios.text: You call home every Sunday, and this Sunday you don't know what to say.

choices.label: Say the truth
choices.result: You tell {parent} you're struggling. He says he's proud of you anyway, and you believe him.

choices.label: Talk about anything else
choices.result: You talk about the weather and his garden for an hour. It helps.

choices.label: Ask him how he got through hard years
choices.result: You ask {parent} how he got through his hardest year. He tells you, and you write it down.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Paycheck Math
scenarios.text: You do the math on your rookie contract and realize how short a career really is.

choices.label: Make a five-year plan
choices.result: You make a five-year plan with your agent and a financial advisor.

choices.label: Make the most of it
choices.result: You decide to make every season count and add an extra workout a week.

choices.label: Try not to think about it
choices.result: You try not to think about it. You sleep less well than you'd like.
